post.title: Loan broker wants a fee first? The SBA watchdog's warning
post.ig:
Loan broker wants cash up front? The SBA's watchdog says: suspect fraud.

FBI IC3: 7,762 advance-fee complaints and $155.9 million lost in 2025, up 53% from $102.1 million in 2024.
FTC and SBA red flags: a fee before funding, guaranteed approval, out-of-the-blue offers, pressure to hurry.
Nov 2025: the FTC banned Seek Capital from business financing ($48.3M judgment, partly suspended) after alleging it pitched business funding but opened personal credit cards and charged 10% of the limits.

Sources: SBA Office of Inspector General, FTC, FBI IC3 2024 and 2025 reports.
News and education, not financial advice.

post.yt_desc:
The SBA's inspector general says that if someone promises SBA loan approval but requires payment up front, suspect fraud. The FBI logged $155.9 million in advance-fee losses in 2025, and the FTC banned Seek Capital from business financing in November 2025 ($48.3 million judgment, partly suspended) after alleging it pitched business funding but opened personal credit cards and charged 10% of the limits. Sources: SBA OIG, FTC, FBI IC3.

News and education, not financial advice.
